name: tarteaucitron.io – Cookie Banner & GDPR Consent Management
author: Amauri

sections.description:
tarteaucitron.io is a French consent management platform (CMP) that helps you manage cookies and third-party services on your WordPress website.

Display a customizable cookie consent banner, let visitors accept or reject services, and manage their preferences from a dedicated consent panel.

The plugin connects your WordPress website to the tarteaucitron.io Pro service, with automatic detection of supported services, an online configuration dashboard and consent statistics.

A 7-day trial is available. A paid tarteaucitron.io license is required after the trial.

Cookie consent management for GDPR / RGPD

Give visitors control over the third-party services used on your website.

  • Display a cookie banner and a consent preferences panel.
  • Offer accept-all and reject-all buttons.
  • Let visitors manage consent for individual services.
  • Allow visitors to reopen the panel and change their preferences.
  • Keep supported services requiring consent blocked until permission is granted when explicit consent is configured.

tarteaucitron.io helps you implement the consent controls needed for your GDPR compliance process. Your website’s compliance also depends on its configuration, the services you use and the information you provide to visitors.

Automatic detection of supported services

Simplify installation with automatic detection of supported third-party services.

Manage analytics, advertising and embedded content through tarteaucitron.io. Check your website after setup to confirm that the services you use are detected and behave correctly before and after consent.

Automatic detection covers supported integrations. Custom scripts and unsupported integrations may require additional configuration.

Google Consent Mode v2

tarteaucitron.io supports Google Consent Mode v2 to communicate visitors’ consent choices to compatible Google tags.

Configure consent settings for your Google integrations and verify their behavior with your analytics and advertising setup.

Consent Mode complements consent collection: it does not replace the cookie banner or the need to configure your tags correctly.

Customize your cookie banner

Adapt the banner to your website from the tarteaucitron.io online dashboard.

  • Customize banner and button colors.
  • Edit the texts shown to visitors.
  • Configure consent options and service settings.
  • Preview your changes.

Accessibility settings

Use a consent interface designed with accessibility in mind, with options for the panel’s position in the document and a link to reopen consent preferences.

When customizing the banner, maintain readable text, sufficient color contrast and usable controls.

Consent statistics

View consent statistics in your tarteaucitron.io dashboard to understand how visitors interact with your consent choices.

Pro service and open-source library

This WordPress plugin integrates the tarteaucitron.io Pro service. It is available with a 7-day trial and requires a paid license after that period.

The tarteaucitron.js JavaScript library is also available separately as a free, open-source project for manual integration. Its availability does not make the Pro service included with this plugin free.

Learn more about tarteaucitron.io
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for tarteaucitron.io.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Open Settings > tarteaucitron.io and follow the instructions to connect your website to the service.
  5. Configure your banner, texts and consent settings in the tarteaucitron.io dashboard.
  6. Test your website before consent, after acceptance and after rejection.

You can also upload the tarteaucitronjs folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
sections.faq:
What is a CMP?

A consent management platform (CMP) helps a website collect and manage visitors’ choices about cookies and third-party services.

tarteaucitron.io provides a cookie banner, a consent preferences panel and tools to configure supported services.

Is this WordPress plugin free to use?

The plugin is free to download and connects your website to the tarteaucitron.io Pro service.

You can try the service for 7 days. A paid license is required to continue using the service after the trial.

What is the difference between this plugin and tarteaucitron.js?

tarteaucitron.js is the free, open-source JavaScript library, available for manual integration.

This plugin connects WordPress to tarteaucitron.io Pro, which adds automatic detection of supported services, online configuration and consent statistics.

Does tarteaucitron.io support GDPR and RGPD consent requirements?

tarteaucitron.io helps you implement cookie and third-party service consent controls for the GDPR, known as RGPD in French.

Installing a CMP alone does not guarantee that an entire website is compliant. Review your service configuration, privacy information and the behavior of your website before and after consent.

Does it support Google Consent Mode v2?

Yes. tarteaucitron.io supports Google Consent Mode v2 for communicating consent choices to compatible Google tags.

You still need to configure your Google services correctly and check that their behavior matches your chosen consent settings.

Does automatic detection cover every script on my website?

Automatic detection handles supported services. Custom scripts, modified integrations or unsupported services may need additional configuration.

Test the actual behavior of your website after installation, including services added through other plugins or a tag manager.

Can visitors reject cookies or change their choices?

Yes. You can display accept-all and reject-all buttons and let visitors manage their preferences for individual services.

Visitors can reopen the consent panel to review or change their choices.

Can I customize the banner?

Yes. You can customize colors, texts and consent options from the tarteaucitron.io online dashboard.

Keep accessibility in mind when changing colors, wording and controls.

Where do I manage my settings?

Use Settings > tarteaucitron.io in WordPress for the plugin’s connection settings.

Manage your banner configuration and consent statistics through your tarteaucitron.io account.
